summary: Implemented the grid-sampled patch feature. Changed files: monai/data/utils.py (iter_patch now yields (patch, coords) pairs; set_rnd skips names starting with "__"; docstring updated), monai/data/grid_dataset.py (new PatchIter; GridPatchDataset rewritten with patch_iter/transform/with_coordinates; PatchDataset docstring uses float; math import removed), monai/data/__init__.py (exports PatchIter), docs/source/data.rst (PatchIter autodoc entry after GridPatchDataset), tests/test_grid_dataset.py (TestGridPatchDataset with test_shape, test_loading_array, test_missing_len). Nothing was run and nothing was committed. Open gap: test_loading_array uses structural checks (exact coordinates, constant per-patch shift in [-1, 1]) instead of the literal patch constants the spec requires, because those depend on a seed I could not compute without running code; replace them with literal values after one test run. The GridPatchDataset docstring example output was derived by hand, not executed.
